- A proposed invoice schedule (we prefer predictable monthly/quarterly draws) and the exact invoice lines so our AP system can map GL codes.

- Confirmation of the entity we should pay (bank/IBAN + beneficiary name) and whether VAT should be charged or reverse-charged for our EU entity.

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoice cadence & VAT evidence needed

Hi Sophie — great to hear. Congrats on getting this across the finish line. I attached a sample invoice and a proposed lockstep calendar (attached) that maps to three operational options. Summary below:

Option A — Monthly equal slices (recommended for smaller AP systems)
- 12 invoices of €20,833.33, issued on the 1st of each month starting 01-Sep-2026.
- Drawdown: automatic netting of usage against prepay; we send monthly consumption reports.

Option B — Quarterly (preferred for reduced invoice volume)
- 4 invoices of €62,500 issued on 01-Sep, 01-Dec, 01-Mar, 01-Jun

Option C — Upfront + Monthly top-ups
- 50% upfront invoice on signature, then 10 equal monthly top-ups for remaining balance.

VAT and entity notes:
- We are able to bill from Redwood EU B.V. (Amsterdam) or Redwood Ltd (UK). For EU-based Brightlane entity, we typically issue invoices from Redwood EU B.V. with VAT lines included where applicable. If Brightlane wants reverse-charge, we can issue a net invoice with VAT fields populated for their tax system to record.
- Please confirm which Brightlane legal entity will receive the invoice (full legal name + VAT registration number).

Attachments: Redwood_Sample_Invoice_AnnualPrepay.pdf (sample showing VAT fields), Prepay-collection-calendar-2026.xlsx (calendar with dates and suggested GL mappings).

Next steps:
1) Sophie — confirm entity name + VAT number and preferred option (A/B/C).
2) AP — confirm bank remittance details once we issue the first invoice.
3) Internal (Kim/Finance) — once Sophie confirms, please set ledger tags and confirm which billing entity to use.

I can issue the first invoice as soon as we have the VAT number and entity confirmation; I’ll schedule it for 01-Sep if we get sign-off today.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
